entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Dotnet test can't find binary logger option on latest rtm build #51249
  • Code from roslyn-analyzers is missing PR and commit history #51241
  • [wasm][coreclr] update the wasm templates and make them work #51240
    11.0.1xx
  • Cannot get hot reload and browser link to work in some projects #51237
  • .NET 10 RC1: dotnet test calls fail when parameters end with .exe or .dll #51235
  • [WebToolsE2E] The SDK 10.0 RTM version displayed in the installer is different from when running `dotnet --info` #51234
  • [WebToolsE2E]Create web project failed with error “Unable to find package Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore with verision 10.0.0 ” after installing SDK 10.0 RTM #51233
  • Bug 2605074: [dotnet-sdk-10.0.100-rtm.25510.110] The exported log text is incomplete after running command "dotnet watch test >.\log.txt". #51232

Closed

  • Improve RID and `publish` UX #26446
  • In net6, Can I GeneratePackageOnBuild for a SingleFile console application #26419
  • Aliased packs are not resolved correctly from TargetingPackName/RuntimePackRuntimeIdentifiers in KnownFrameworkReference items #26384
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51174
  • Project reference in a nuget package generating project causes NU1101 in consumer project #51238
